customManagers.description: Update npm tools pinned inline in workflow run commands (e.g. npm install -g @cyclonedx/cdxgen@1.2.3). No built-in manager reads versions out of run: commands, so without this the pins drift silently.
Update GitHub-release pins inline in workflow run commands (helm plugin install <url> --version X). No built-in manager reads versions out of run: commands, so without this the pins drift silently.

Update tool versions declared as `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` followed by a `key: vX.Y.Z` line in workflows (setup-helm version, kubeconform and helm-docs downloads). The version is declared once, so URLs built from it can never end up half-updated. The SHA-256 next to a downloaded tool is not updated automatically: take it from the release's checksum file, otherwise CI fails the checksum check.

packageRules.description: No major postgres image updates in the Helm chart. The bundled database hardcodes PGDATA=/var/lib/postgresql/18/docker, so a major bump breaks existing PVCs. Minor and patch bumps are allowed but need the chart README regenerated (helm-docs) because the image tag appears in it.
minimumReleaseAge cannot be enforced for these update types (the package manager performs the resolution); without this they would be filtered as permanently pending and never raised as PRs

Pin conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits to v9. @semantic-release/release-notes-generator only devDepends on it, so we must provide it as a direct dependency, and it must match the release notes generator's template engine (conventional-changelog-writer@8 / Handlebars). v10 ships templates for writer@9, which renders empty release notes. Revisit once release-notes-generator upgrades to writer@9.
